title: Intracranial EEG Epilepsy - Studies 3, 5 and 6 (Mayo Clinic; IEEG.org)
description: Long-term clinical intracranial EEG recordings from three patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) using subdural grid/strip and depth electrodes. The dataset includes expert seizure annotations, with data originally shared via the IEEG.org portal and Pennsieve Discover (Studies 3, 5 and 6). Recordings were converted losslessly from MEF 2.0 to BIDS iEEG in BrainVision format at 500 Hz, split into runs at recording discontinuities, with participant metadata and seizure events.
methods_description: Clinical intracranial EEG was acquired with an XLTek EEG 128 system at 500 Hz (0.1 Hz high-pass hardware filter) from subdural grids/strips (ECoG) and depth electrodes (SEEG). MEF 2.0 files were decoded with mef_lib_2_1 with block CRC validation, split into runs at MEF discontinuities, and written as lossless INT_32 BrainVision files. Events come from IEEG.org annotation layers placed using MEF block timestamps.
